subject: Fix enum constants, constructor initialization, and native string joins
body:
Fix enum constants, constructor initialization, and native string joins

Support compile-time enum member expressions, including bitwise combinations of preceding members and shift-based values, while preserving overflow and underlying-type validation.

Allow simple assignments to get-only auto-properties inside their declaring instance constructor by targeting the generated backing field without synthesizing a setter. Keep assignments from ordinary methods and through other instances rejected.

Allow equality and inequality comparisons between enums and the integer literal zero. Materialize the enum conversion during HIR lowering so enums with non-int underlying types remain verifier-correct, while nonzero integer comparisons remain invalid.

Use the existing implicit string-literal-to-native-string conversion when one conditional-expression branch is a string literal and the other is a builtin string. Preserve lazy evaluation and continue rejecting unrelated branch types.

Add focused semantic and negative tests, O0/O2 execution coverage, NSLink coverage, and corresponding language-specification and conformance updates.

subject: Documenta la unión condicional de strings nativos / Document native string conditional joins
body:
ES: Registra el defecto, la regla estrecha entre string-literal y builtin:string, los archivos y funciones modificados, la decisión de no introducir una unión general al estilo C# y la evidencia enfocada del cambio incluido en 5a9ed611.

EN: Record the defect, the narrow string-literal/builtin:string rule, the modified files and functions, the decision not to introduce a general C#-style join, and the focused evidence for the change included in 5a9ed611.

subject: Corrige literales positivos que requieren ulong / Fix positive literals that require ulong
body:
ES: Tipa como ulong los literales positivos sin sufijo que exceden long.MaxValue, conserva la regla especial de los mínimos negativos y agrega cobertura directa para ulong.MaxValue. Restaura la ejecución de enums de 64 bits y el diagnóstico de que no existe sucesor después del máximo.

EN: Type unsuffixed positive literals above long.MaxValue as ulong, preserve the special rule for negative minima, and add direct ulong.MaxValue coverage. Restore 64-bit enum execution and the no-successor diagnostic after the maximum value.

subject: Permite préstamos temporales de string en constructores / Allow temporary string borrows in constructors
body:
ES: Aplica a new, this y base la misma regla de préstamo de expresión completa usada por las llamadas ordinarias. Mantiene vivos los strings owned frescos mediante un owner oculto, permite literales con duración de proceso y conserva el rechazo de escapes desde parámetros borrowed.

EN: Apply the same full-expression borrow rule used by ordinary calls to new, this, and base. Keep fresh owned strings alive through a hidden owner, allow process-lifetime literals, and retain escape rejection for borrowed parameters.

subject: Habilita el baseline G00 desde consola / Enable the G00 baseline from the command line
body:
ES: Comparte el plan G0.2 entre la interfaz gráfica y la consola, permite seleccionar el paralelismo y devuelve códigos de salida aptos para automatización. Conserva la matriz completa, los reportes históricos y la certificación Gate 0 del runner existente.

EN: Share the G0.2 plan between the GUI and command line, allow selecting parallelism, and return automation-friendly exit codes. Preserve the complete matrix, historical reports, and Gate 0 certification from the existing runner.

subject: Registra el baseline certificado de NativeSharp 1.0.1 / Record the certified NativeSharp 1.0.1 baseline
body:
ES: Registra la corrida G00 completa de strings y enums con ambos enlazadores y niveles de optimización. Conserva la corrida roja que descubrió el rango ulong, la identidad exacta del compilador, los hashes S0/S1 y el resultado final LANDED.

EN: Record the complete G00 strings-and-enums run with both linkers and optimization levels. Preserve the red run that exposed the ulong range issue, the exact compiler identity, the S0/S1 hashes, and the final LANDED result.

subject: Define la política local de historial de desarrollo / Define the local development history policy
body:
ES: Establece una unidad de historia por cambio con documentación técnica numerada, commits bilingües, verificación enfocada y baseline G00 para cambios ejecutables. Define también la separación de artefactos generados y la evidencia mínima que debe conservar cada certificación.

EN: Establish one history unit per change with numbered technical documentation, bilingual commits, focused verification, and a G00 baseline for executable changes. Also define generated-artifact separation and the minimum evidence retained for each certification.

subject: Fix enum constants, constructor initialization, and native string semantics
body:
Support compile-time enum member expressions, including bitwise combinations and shift-based values, while preserving overflow and underlying-type validation.

Allow simple assignments to get-only auto-properties inside their declaring instance constructor without synthesizing a setter. Keep writes from ordinary methods and through other instances rejected.

Allow equality and inequality comparisons between enums and the integer literal zero while keeping nonzero integer comparisons invalid.

Use the existing string-literal-to-native-string conversion when joining conditional-expression branches, preserving lazy evaluation and rejecting unrelated types.

Allow process-lifetime string literals and fresh owned string temporaries to cross explicit borrowed-string method and constructor parameters. Materialize hidden owners for constructor arguments and destroy them at the end of the full expression, including exceptional exits. Preserve escape analysis so borrowed constructor parameters cannot be stored in longer-lived fields.

Add focused semantic and negative tests, O0/O2 execution coverage, LLD and NSLink coverage, and corresponding specification and conformance updates.

subject: Unifica el historial de cambios de NativeSharp 1.0.1 / Consolidate the NativeSharp 1.0.1 change history
body:
ES: Reúne commit por commit la implementación, archivos, funciones, decisiones, pruebas y evidencia del baseline de la serie de enums, strings y ownership de NativeSharp 1.0.1. Registra también el antecedente de artefactos generados y la política aplicada a los commits posteriores.

EN: Consolidate, commit by commit, the implementation, files, functions, decisions, tests, and baseline evidence for the NativeSharp 1.0.1 enum, string, and ownership series. Also record the generated-artifact precedent and the policy applied to later commits.

subject: Define el contrato estándar PDB/CodeView de NativeSharp / Define NativeSharp's standard PDB/CodeView contract
body:
ES: Define perfiles de depuración independientes de optimización, artefactos PDB y RSDS estándar, el perfil mínimo archivo/función/línea, la meta completa de locales y tipos y las pruebas obligatorias con LLVM, lld-link y llvm-pdbutil.

EN: Define optimization-independent debug profiles, standard PDB and RSDS artifacts, the minimum file/function/line profile, the complete locals-and-types target, and the required LLVM, lld-link and llvm-pdbutil evidence.

subject: Agrega la primera ruta PDB/CodeView / Add the first PDB/CodeView path
body:
ES: Separa los perfiles -g de la optimización, emite archivos, funciones y líneas CodeView desde el MIR y enlaza ejecutables con PDB/RSDS estándar. Agrega validación O0/O2, documenta la implementación completa y certifica G00 en ambos carriles de linker.

EN: Separates -g profiles from optimization, emits CodeView files, functions and lines from MIR, and links executables with standard PDB/RSDS data. Adds O0/O2 validation, documents the complete implementation, and certifies G00 across both linker lanes.

subject: Agrega parámetros, locales y tipos al PDB estándar / Add parameters, locals and types to the standard PDB
body:
ES: Transporta nombres fuente de HIR a MIR, modela tipos NativeSharp con DIBuilder, emite declaraciones de parámetros y locales sobre sus hogares ABI reales y endurece el gate para validar tipos y rangos en O0/O2 sin contaminar line-tables-only.

EN: Transports source names from HIR to MIR, models NativeSharp types with DIBuilder, emits parameter and local declarations over their real ABI homes, and hardens the gate to validate types and ranges at O0/O2 without polluting line-tables-only.

subject: Amplía el PDB con structs, scopes y thunks / Extend PDB with structs, scopes and thunks
body:
ES: Transporta layouts de campos autoritativos a MIR, publica this y variables en scopes léxicos reales, y clasifica wrappers C y guards de callbacks como S_THUNK32. Certificado por Gate 0 con ambas matrices.

EN: Transports authoritative field layouts into MIR, publishes this and variables in real lexical scopes, and classifies C wrappers and callback guards as S_THUNK32. Certified by Gate 0 across both matrices.

subject: Demanda implementaciones genéricas usadas por interfaces / Demand generic implementations used by interfaces
body:
ES: Trata cada slot concreto de una tabla de interfaz como demanda ejecutable, evita que HIR omita métodos de tipos genéricos cerrados y agrega una regresión invocada sólo mediante la interfaz.

EN: Treats each concrete interface-table slot as executable demand, prevents HIR from omitting closed-generic type methods, and adds a regression invoked only through the interface.

subject: Conserva el origen declarador en especializaciones externas / Preserve declaration origins in external specializations
body:
Propaga el proyecto y namespace de la declaración canónica al clonar argumentos genéricos externos. Permite que un consumidor cree la primera Dictionary<string, T> sobre tipos de otra biblioteca y agrega cobertura de clases, structs, interfaces, tipos anidados y referencias transitivas.

Propagates the canonical declaration project and namespace when cloning external generic arguments. Allows a consumer to create the first Dictionary<string, T> over types from another library and adds coverage for classes, structs, interfaces, nested types, and transitive references.

subject: Corrige descriptores y API precompilada / Fix precompiled descriptors and API
body:
ES: Resuelve bases de clases precompiladas mediante accessors PE-safe y publica la cadena con cmpxchg cuando una clase local hereda de NativeSharp.Core.Object u otro tipo externo. Evita además que imports extern C no exportados se reconstruyan como métodos NativeSharp inexistentes. Agrega regresiones de bibliotecas estáticas, DLL, Object implícito y dependencias nativas privadas.

EN: Resolve precompiled class bases through PE-safe accessors and publish the chain with cmpxchg when a local class inherits from NativeSharp.Core.Object or another external type. Also prevent non-exported extern C imports from being reconstructed as nonexistent NativeSharp methods. Add regressions for static libraries, DLLs, the implicit Object root, and private native dependencies.

subject: Sincroniza constructores genericos con NSMETA / Synchronize generic constructors with NSMETA
body: Separa la validacion de simbolos fisicos de la materializacion de API precompilada, incluye constructores publicos de structs genericos en el contrato de exportaciones y agrega una regresion DLL+LIB+NSMETA. / Separate physical symbol validation from precompiled API materialization, include public generic struct constructors in the export contract, and add a DLL+LIB+NSMETA regression.

subject: Expone funciones sintetizadas en PDB / Expose synthesized functions in PDB
body: Publica inicializadores estaticos, entradas de destruccion, filtros EH tipados y destructores de contextos de closures como procedimientos CodeView artificiales con firma y origen, preserva los thunks ABI y amplia el gate O0/O2 con ejecucion. / Publish static initializers, destruction entries, typed EH filters, and closure-context destructors as artificial CodeView procedures with signatures and origins, preserve ABI thunks, and expand the O0/O2 gate with execution.

subject: fixes
Consolida las regresiones de DLLs precompiladas / Consolidate precompiled DLL regressions
body:
ES: Publica tipos públicos autónomos al reconstruir API desde NSMETA y agrega un corpus interno que produce, verifica, consume y ejecuta dos DLLs sin fuentes de los productores.

EN: Publish standalone public types when rebuilding API from NSMETA and add an internal corpus that builds, verifies, consumes, and executes two DLLs without producer sources.

subject: Agrega identidad reproducible de fuentes PDB / Add reproducible PDB source identity
body:
Emite checksums SHA-256 sobre los bytes compilados, agrega remapeo normalizado de prefijos de fuente y amplía el gate con rutas privadas, multiarchivo, basenames duplicados, fuente modificada y reproducibilidad entre checkouts. Hace además robusta la evidencia Stage 61 ante archivos LF o CRLF.

Emit SHA-256 checksums over compiled bytes, add normalized source-prefix remapping, and extend the gate with private-path, multi-file, duplicate-basename, modified-source, and cross-checkout reproducibility coverage. Also make Stage 61 evidence robust to LF or CRLF files.

subject: Amplía los tipos NativeSharp en PDB / Expand NativeSharp types in PDB
body: Emite enums, jerarquías de clases, structs y unions con layout autoritativo, además de arrays, strings, delegates, genéricos cerrados y capturas con ubicación real. Amplía el fixture y el gate O0/O2 para validar la superficie de tipos y closures.\n\nEmit enums, class hierarchies, structs and unions with authoritative layout, plus arrays, strings, delegates, closed generics, and captures with real locations. Expand the O0/O2 fixture and gate to validate the type and closure surface.

subject: Endurece el PDB para código optimizado / Harden PDB for optimized code
body: Actualiza la ubicación de capturas con su valor SSA cargado y conserva únicamente rangos válidos bajo O2. Endurece el gate para constantes, valores eliminados, registros, stack, fragmentos, huecos e inline sites.\n\nUpdate captured-variable locations with their loaded SSA value and retain only valid ranges under O2. Harden the gate for constants, optimized-away values, registers, stack, fragments, gaps, and inline sites.

subject: Cierra el handoff CodeView al linker / Close the CodeView linker handoff

Documenta la medición honesta de NSLink 0.1.0 y mantiene NSL-30 como responsabilidad externa.\n\nVerify at O0 and O2 that objects hand off complete CodeView symbol/type sections, relocations, and records before linking. Document the honest NSLink 0.1.0 measurement and retain NSL-30 as an external responsibility.
